summary: Inhibrx Biosciences filed an 8-K on May 11, 2026, announcing clinical updates for INBRX-106 in first-line HNSCC, including interim Phase 2 data from the HexAgon study. The press release and corporate presentation were furnished under Items 7.01 and 8.01. No merger, acquisition, tender offer, activist, or other special-situation transaction was disclosed. The filing is a routine disclosure of clinical trial results and corporate materials, not a special situation.
